import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, exact, fab, ref
rng = random.Random(44)
profile, inc, x = gen.gen_profile(rng)
fabric, P = gen.gen_fabric(rng, K=profile['groups'])
fabric2 = json.loads(json.dumps(fabric))
fabric2['links'][0]['ends'][1][0] = 0
cal = ref.ref_calibration(profile)
_, D, H, C = cal
P2,N2,T2,S2,fsl,fro,VR = ref.ref_setup(fabric2)
anchors = fabric2['anchors']
def anchored(i,p):
    return any(a==i and st<=p<en for (a,st,en) in anchors)
hops_at=[[] for _ in range(P2)]
for p in range(P2):
    for lid in fabric2['slices'][fsl[p]]:
        for dr in (0,1):
            code=2*lid+dr
            l,frm,to,d,q,m,L = ref.ref_dir(fabric2, code)
            gmax = min(fro[p], S2-d-fro[p])
            # NOTE: ref_plan builds hops_at WITHOUT blackout filtering!!
            cost = H[frm[2]][to[2]] + ref.ref_aging(VR,to[0],p,d,m,q,P2,T2)
            hops_at[p].append((code,frm[0],to[0],L,cost,gmax,m))
for p in range(P2):
    print('hops_at', p, hops_at[p])
PYEOF
